title: ChatRequest
description: Body of POST /chat of the LLM agent (agent-openapi.yaml): one question of a conversation about one astronaut. The client generates `conversation_id`: a new id starts a new conversation, the same id continues it (the agent keeps the history in memory; the client never sends it). A conversation belongs to the astronaut of its first question.

astronaut_id.description: The astronaut the conversation is about. Must equal the X-Astronaut-Id header (the unlocked astronaut).

question.description: What the astronaut asks, as typed. 1 to 2000 characters, at least one of them not blank.
